The SR-3 collects roughly 10,000 UT readings per square foot (2-4 per millimeter), building out the most comprehensive view of tank integrity.

Square Robot's submersible is equipped with a sensor package that measures the tank bottom elevation as it traverses across the tank, building out a real-time elevation map of tank settlement to an accuracy of within a quarter of an inch. Utilize the SR-3 for the only comprehensive settlement analysis that can be performed while the tank stays online.
doesn't just improve inspection, it transforms it. Here's what changes when your tanks are inspected by Square Robot.
The SR-3 performs complete internal tank inspections without requiring a single worker to enter the tank, eliminating the most significant safety hazard in traditional inspection programs.

Because the SR-3 operates while the tank remains in service, often even inspecting while the tank is flowing, there is no need for shutdown, cleaning, or product removal. Inspections that once required weeks of preparation can now be completed in days.
Eliminating tank cleaning, product removal, degassing and production downtime translates directly to significant cost savings, often hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars per inspection.

Structured, digitized inspection data integrates with maintenance planning, risk-based inspection programs, and asset lifecycle management, giving operators a clearer picture of tank condition across their entire portfolio.
See how the SR-3 navigates tank environments, captures precision inspection data, and delivers results that meet the highest regulatory standards, without a single worker entering the tank.

The SR-3 is designed for flexible deployment, entering tanks through roof or shell manways or hatches depending on tank configuration, product type, and customer requirements. Both methods are engineered to maintain safety, minimize preparation time, and ensure a successful inspection.

The SR-3 is lowered into the tank through a 24 inch roof manway or hatch, one of the most common deployment methods for fixed-roof and external floating roof storage tanks. This approach minimizes the surface footprint of the inspection setup and reduces the time required for pre-inspection preparation.
Minimal surface preparation required
Safe, controlled deployment process
The SR-3 can also be deployed through a side-shell manway, providing an effective solution for tanks where roof deployment is not suitable or where tank configuration favors side access.
The SR-3 performs full internal tank inspections without requiring workers to enter to confined space, which has a disproportionately high risk rate according to OSHA.
The SR-3 inspection process is designed to satisfy API 653, EEMUA 159, and applicable jurisdictional requirements, with full documentation to support compliance audits.
FM Approval and other independent certifications confirm that Square Robot's technology meets rigorous third-party safety and performance standards.

Square Robot's SR-3 platform has earned independent validation through rigorous industry certification programs. Our credentials reflect the technical integrity of our inspection technology and the safety standards embedded in every deployment.
Duration depends on tank size, configuration, and scope of the inspection program. Your team can provide a timeline estimate based on your specific assets and reporting requirements.

The robot weighs 265 lbs in air but achieves approximately 10 lbs of negative buoyancy when submerged in a distillate. An attached foam pack, configured with foam slices and ballast weights, ensures optimal performance. This setup allows the robot to rest on the tank floor, move smoothly along the bottom, and hover or navigate efficiently throughout the tank using its eight thrusters.
Do you collect video footage or still images when conducting the tank inspections?

We capture video footage from two high-definition cameras on the robot and extract still images from the recorded footage of key areas of interest that we include in the final report. However, image quality can be affected by visibility within the product.

Six Reasons Operators
Square Robot's autonomous, submersible inspection robot follows a structured, repeatable path, giving operators the ability to trend tank corrosion with more accurate data more frequent intervals.

Structured, digitized inspection data integrates with maintenance planning, risk-based inspection programs, and asset lifecycle management, giving operators a clearer picture of tank condition across their entire portfolio.

Aboveground storage tanks are critical infrastructure across the global economy, storing refined fuels, chemical feedstocks, aviation fuel, and industrial materials that keep entire industries functioning. Regular API 653-compliant inspection is not just a regulatory requirement, it is essential to protecting workers, communities, and assets from the consequences of tank failure.

Square Robot's SR-3 robotic inspection platform gives operators in every major tank-dependent industry a safer, faster, and more accurate way to keep tanks compliant, without taking tanks out of service.

Refineries operate large-volume storage tanks that require regular API 653-compliant inspection. Traditional out-of-service inspections are costly and disruptive, often taking tanks offline for weeks or months at a time. Square Robot's SR-3 platform enables refinery operators to meet inspection requirements without shutdown, reducing costs and maintaining operational continuity.

Midstream operators manage extensive networks of pipeline terminals, storage hubs, and distribution facilities, all relying on aboveground storage tanks that must be regularly inspected. Square Robot supports midstream inspection programs across North America and globally, helping operators maintain infrastructure reliability while minimizing operational disruption.

Square Robot's SR-3 platform is certified and compliant with ASTM D1655, enabling aviation fuel operators to conduct thorough internal tank inspections while maintaining fuel availability with no product removal, no contamination risk, and no downtime.

Ethanol and biofuel production facilities rely on large aboveground storage tanks for feedstocks, blend stocks, and finished product — often operating under continuous production cycles that make traditional out-of-service inspection costly and disruptive. Square Robot's in-service inspection technology helps renewable energy operators maintain tank integrity without shutting down production.

Power plants cannot afford unplanned shutdowns — and neither can their storage tanks. From fossil fuel facilities to nuclear plants operating under the strictest regulatory oversight in any industrial sector, Square Robot inspects on your schedule, minimizing human exposure in sensitive environments, supporting compliance documentation, and delivering the accuracy your operations demand.
